What new service begins on March 26, 2026, in rail transport in Europe?

[2026 in rail transport] This article lists events related to rail transport that are currently scheduled to occur in 2026. Please be aware that the actual dates on which these events occur may differ substantially from what is shown here.

[2026 in rail transport]
26 March – European Sleeper begins a night train service between Paris, Brussels, and Berlin.
– Train service resumes on the Ihrhove–Nieuweschans railway, with two new stations in Bunde and Ihrhove.
– Grand Central starts  operating passenger services between  Newcastle upon Tyne and Brighton.
– New Stadler FLIRT electric and battery-electric trains enter service.
– FGC takes over operation of lines RL3 and RL4 of the Lleida commuter railway service with new Stadler FLIRT trainsets.

A new rail service, the European Sleeper, will begin on March 26, 2026, providing a night train service between Paris, Brussels, and Berlin. 

FINAL: European Sleeper night train service
